newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - AGA Q1 net profit 367 mln skr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - AGA Q1 net profit 367 mln skr.

text.p: Swedish industrial and medical gas company AGA AB was expected to post a profit of 367 million crowns after financial items for the first quarter of 1997, analysts polled by Reuters said.
The figure, the average of 11 analysts' forecasts, compares to 525 million crowns the company posted for the first quarter of 1996.
For 1997 the company was expected to post a profit of 1.84 billion crowns compared with 1.76 billion crowns reported for 1996, the poll showed.
A poll conducted before AGA reported its 1996 profit showed analysts had downgraded expectations from average expectations for a profit of 1.98 billion crowns.
AGA's result after financial items for the first quarter and the full year is expected to reflect costs of around 100 million crowns because of staff cuts, the company said.
(Million crowns) average range number of responses
Sources who participated in the survey were from: Carnegie, Den Danske Bank, Fiba Nordic, Handelsbanken, JP Morgan, Kleinwort Benson, Matteus, Morgan Grenfell Paribas and Swedbank.
